Canadian UFO files

                   Locating official copies of relevant pages



The purpose of this document is explained by Isaac Koi in his post at:
http://www.abovetopsecret.com/forum/thread736264/pg1

The content of the relevant Canadian UFO files was outlined in another post,
at:
http://www.abovetopsecret.com/forum/thread736264/pg1

Basically:
   (a)     The left hand column below lists each page number within Isaac Koi’s
           PDF archive of Canadian UFO documents
   (b)     The right hand column gives the corresponding long “e” number,
           which forms part of URL for that page on the official Canadian website.

For example, if you want to find an official copy of page number 5063 in Isaac
Koi’s PDF archive then just scroll down to the line beginning “5063” (or do a
search for “5063.” – note the full stop after the number) and you’ll find the
corresponding “e” number (“e002749627”) indicating that the relevant page is at:

http://data2.collectionscanada.gc.ca/e/e110/e002749627.jpg



The precise URL varies slightly depending on which block of URLs the long
“e” number falls within. The URLs are in different blocks containing different
short “e” number (e.g. “e110”, or “e110”, or “e120”), depending on the
long “e” number. The relevant blocks are:

(a) from /e/e110/e002744278.jpg to /e/e110/e002749999.jpg

(b) from /e/e111/e002750000.jpg to /e/e111/e002750209.jpg :Posted by
    freelance_zenarchist

(c) from /e/e111/e002750306.jpg to /e/e111/e002751233.jpg

(d) from /e112/e002799600.jpg to /e112/e002799811.jpg :Posted by
    freelance_zenarchist

(e) from /e/e120/ e002996914.jpg to /e/e120/e002996931.jpg

(f) from /e/e120/e002997366.jpg to /e/e120/e002997414.jpg :Posted by ArMaP

(g) from /e/e120/e002997420.jpg to /e/e120/e002997675.jpg :Posted by
    freelance_zenarchist
(h) from /e/e120/e002999664.jpg to /e/e120/e002999999.jpg

(i) from /e/e121/e003000000.jpg to /e/e121/e003001631.jpg
